about: Allowlist of the quality ratchet (tools/quality_ratchet.py). data_files: glob (repo-relative, forward slashes) -> reason; a matching file is not measured, so declare only data and generated files (the Suite's size_exempt list in tools/tests/suite_structure_allowlist.json counts as well). A baselined file that leaves measurement fails the check. allowed: one entry per file and metric that may exceed the baseline up to max, each with a reason and a date (YYYY-MM-DD); --update prunes entries the new baseline already covers.

allowed.reason: The Group Finder eye (LFGParentFramePortrait) has no parentKey on its parent; its global name is the only reference. Forever-only, guarded like the other LFG frames.

QuestLogMicroButton is Blizzard's own quest log button: the tracker clicks it so the quest log opens from Blizzard's code (quest pins' SetPassThroughButtons is blocked in combat when the Suite writes the focused quest). It has no parentKey route; guarded by IsForbidden, IsShown and IsEnabled.
